module origen_091016 #(
    parameter WIDTH = 60,
    parameter HEIGHT = 30
) (
    input wire clk,
    input wire flip_even,
    input wire flip_odd,
    input wire next_data,
    output reg reset,
    output reg [7:0] array_x,
    output reg [7:0] array_y,
    output reg next_frame
);

reg [7:0] x;
reg [7:0] y;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (next_data) begin
        if (reset) begin
            x <= 0;
            y <= 0;
            reset <= 0;
        end else begin
            if (x == WIDTH - 1) begin
                x <= 0;
                if (y == HEIGHT - 1) begin
                    y <= 0;
                    next_frame <= 1;
                    reset <= 1;
                end else begin
                    y <= y + 1;
                end
            end else begin
                x <= x + 1;
            end
        end
    end else if (next_frame) begin
        next_frame <= 0;
    end
end

always @(*) begin
    if ((y[0] && flip_odd) || (!y[0] && flip_even)) begin
        array_x = WIDTH - 1 - x;
    end else begin
        array_x = x;
    end
    array_y = y;
end

endmodule
